note: First-pass labels — see evaluation/corpora/README.md. Every entry humanVerified:false. Metrics vs this corpus are indicative, not a validated accuracy claim.

entries.text: Tamil Nadu government to launch health insurance for the elderly
entries.rationale: Reports a policy launch; no evaluative language about the government.

entries.text: T.N. CM announces major drinking water and underground sewage projects for Madurai; ₹1,850-cr for road repairs
entries.rationale: 'announces' + figures; factual, no positive/negative frame.

entries.text: “This government has become a huge tragedy for women”: Udhayanidhi's accusation against the Chief Minister
entries.rationale: The article reports an opposition accusation. Author frames it as 'X's accusation' — descriptive. Quoted speaker (Udhayanidhi) is CRITICAL of the CM.

entries.text: Rahul Gandhi will help Tamil Nadu CM Vijay become Prime Minister in 2029: TVK MLA
entries.rationale: Author reports a claim ('X: TVK MLA'); the quoted MLA is boosterish toward the CM.

entries.text: Tamil Nadu government to withdraw cases filed against farmers, teachers during DMK regime: CM Vijay
entries.rationale: Factual report of a withdrawal; the CM's framing ('cases filed during DMK regime') is implicitly critical of the previous DMK government.

entries.text: Madras High Court dismisses M.K. Stalin’s plea to declare him elected from Kolathur constituency
entries.rationale: Court outcome reported plainly.

entries.text: Setback for MK Stalin as High Court rejects plea against TVK's Kolathur win
entries.rationale: 'Setback for MK Stalin' is an evaluative frame casting the outcome negatively for the DMK leader.

entries.text: Madras HC dismisses MK Stalin’s plea challenging Vijay team's Kolathur victory
entries.rationale: Same event as s007 but framed neutrally ('dismisses ... plea challenging').

entries.text: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay Announces World-Class Olympic City In Chennai, Dedicated Motorsports Centre
entries.rationale: 'World-class' is the announcement's own wording quoted in the headline; overall the sentence reports an announcement.

entries.text: DMK’s in a mood of reflection and retrospection
entries.rationale: Analytical/opinion headline; tone is neither clearly supportive nor critical without the body.

entries.text: Madras High Court sets aside conviction, imprisonment imposed on BJP leader H. Raja in two criminal cases
entries.rationale: Court outcome reported factually.

entries.text: Congress not a ‘slave’ to TVK-led alliance, says party leader in Puducherry
entries.rationale: Author reports a party leader's statement; the quote asserts independence (defensive, mildly adversarial toward the alliance).

entries.text: Bill to set up Tamil Nadu Investment Promotion Commission, fast-track clearances introduced in Assembly
entries.rationale: Legislative event; descriptive.

entries.text: When the Election Commission cancelled a bypoll in Tamil Nadu after Jayalalithaa launched welfare schemes
entries.rationale: Historical recap framing; no evaluation of the EC in the headline.

entries.text: Is Tamil Nadu Finance Minister the King of England to avoid court appearance, asks judge
entries.rationale: Author reports a judge's sharp remark; the quoted judge is critical of the minister.

entries.text: TN Assembly adopts resolution urging Centre to recognise Tamil as High Court's principal language
entries.rationale: Reports a resolution; the implicit ask puts mild pressure on the Centre but the frame is procedural.

entries.text: Supreme Court declines to entertain plea challenging curbs on journalists’, activists’ entry
entries.rationale: Court outcome reported plainly.

entries.text: AI fraud in the Chief Minister’s name: scammers share a WhatsApp number to extort money
entries.rationale: The CM is the victim/subject of an impersonation scam; no stance toward the CM.

entries.text: Government's total failure exposed as water crisis worsens across four districts
entries.rationale: 'total failure exposed' is explicit negative evaluation of the government.

entries.text: Tamil Nadu hailed for record welfare rollout as officials credit the state's delivery model
entries.rationale: 'hailed', 'credit ... delivery model' — positive evaluation.

entries.text: BJP slams DMK over Katchatheevu, demands white paper
entries.rationale: Author reports a political attack ('X slams Y'); the quoted BJP is critical of the DMK — but the article's own stance toward the BJP is descriptive.

entries.text: Opposition alleges corruption in DMK-era road contracts; government orders probe
entries.rationale: Reports an allegation and a probe order; the quoted opposition is critical of the DMK.

entries.text: Centre defends GDP estimates, says revisions reflect updated data and methodology
entries.rationale: Reports the government's defence; 'defends' is descriptive of a response.

entries.text: Modi government's Swadeshi push draws praise from industry leaders for boosting local demand
entries.rationale: 'draws praise ... for boosting' — positive framing of a government initiative.

entries.text: AIADMK’s alliance calculus in disarray weeks before the campaign
entries.rationale: 'in disarray' is a negative evaluative frame.

entries.text: CM Vijay opens Mettur dam, releases Cauvery water for irrigation
entries.rationale: Factual event report.

entries.text: Tamil Nadu Assembly | Files on sanitation workers’ demands ready, says Minister
entries.rationale: Minister presents the government favourably; author frames it as 'says Minister' — descriptive.

entries.text: Residents block key stretch near Ambur demanding resumption of water supply
entries.rationale: Reports a protest; the protest is implicitly critical of the water utility/govt but the headline frame is event-descriptive.

entries.text: A masterstroke: CM's surprise infrastructure blitz wins over sceptics
entries.rationale: 'masterstroke', 'wins over sceptics' — clearly positive.

entries.text: GST collections rise 14.8% to ₹1.99 trillion in August; refunds jump 68%
entries.rationale: Data report; no evaluative framing of the government despite positive numbers.

entries.text: Governor sits on 10 Bills for months, stalling the Assembly's agenda
entries.rationale: 'sits on', 'stalling' — negative evaluation of the Governor's conduct.

entries.text: Tamil Nadu Assembly passes resolution on Cauvery management board
entries.rationale: Procedural report.

entries.text: DMK delivers on manifesto promise with elderly health cover, but critics flag funding gap
entries.rationale: 'delivers on manifesto promise' (positive) + 'critics flag funding gap' (negative) both substantive.

entries.text: BJP’s Tamil Nadu unit gains ground in the delta, but internal rifts persist
entries.rationale: 'gains ground' + 'internal rifts persist' — both.

entries.text: Sovereign rating upgrade vindicates the Centre's fiscal path, say analysts — opposition unconvinced
entries.rationale: 'vindicates' (positive) balanced by 'opposition unconvinced'.

entries.text: AIADMK holds cadre meeting in Salem
entries.rationale: Bare event.

entries.text: PMK reshuffles district secretaries ahead of polls
entries.rationale: Organisational news, descriptive.

entries.text: Is this leadership or theatre? CM's daily announcements raise more questions than answers
entries.rationale: Rhetorical question + 'more questions than answers' — negative evaluation.

entries.text: Supreme Court asks Prashant Bhushan to approach Delhi High Court in case of lawyers beaten
entries.rationale: Procedural court report.

entries.text: VCK welcomes the Assembly resolution on Tamil in courts
entries.rationale: Reports VCK's welcome; the party is supportive of the resolution.

entries.text: சென்னையில் உலகத்தரம் வாய்ந்த தமிழ்நாடு ஒலிம்பிக் நகரம் அமைக்கப்படும்: முதல்வர் விஜய்
entries.rationale: 'அமைக்கப்படும் ... முதல்வர் விஜய்' — reports an announcement ('a world-class TN Olympic City will be built: CM Vijay'). Descriptive.

entries.text: திமுக தலைவர் மு.க.ஸ்டாலின் தொடர்ந்த தேர்தல் வழக்கு தள்ளுபடி
entries.rationale: 'DMK leader M.K. Stalin's election case dismissed' — court outcome, factual.

entries.text: “இந்த ஆட்சி, பெண்களுக்கு மிகப்பெரிய டிராஜடியாக மாறிவிட்டது” - முதல்வர் மீது உதயநிதி குற்றச்சாட்டு
entries.rationale: Author: 'Udhayanidhi's accusation against the CM'. Quote: 'this government has become a huge tragedy for women' — quotedStance CRITICAL.

entries.text: ராகுல் காந்திக்கு எதிராக வழக்கு; காங்கிரஸ் கண்டன ஆர்ப்பாட்டம்!
entries.rationale: 'case against Rahul Gandhi; Congress protest' — reports a protest; Congress's stance is adversarial toward the case/complainant, not measurable as pro/anti-Congress by the author.

entries.text: பாஸ்போர்ட் அலுவலகத்திற்கு வந்த விஜய்; அண்ணா சாலையில் திரண்ட மக்கள் கூட்டம்
entries.rationale: 'Vijay visits the passport office; crowds gather on Anna Salai' — event report. 'Crowds gather' is a neutral observation, not advocacy.

entries.text: ரேஷன்கடைகளில் வெங்காயம் விற்பனை தொடக்கம்
entries.rationale: 'Onion sales begin at ration shops' — a scheme report, factual.

entries.text: மெட்டூர் அணை செலவை விட, முதல்வர் வருகைக்கான செலவு அதிகம் என பாஜக தலைவர் குற்றச்சாட்டு
entries.rationale: 'BJP chief alleges the CM's travel cost exceeds the Mettur dam repair cost' — reports an allegation; the BJP is critical of the government.

entries.text: கையில் பேப்பரோடு CM விஜய் சொன்ன வார்த்தை - பேரவையில் செம சீன்..!
entries.rationale: 'CM Vijay's words, paper in hand — a big scene in the Assembly'. Colourful/tabloid framing but not evaluative pro/anti the CM.

entries.text: முதல்வரின் அறிவிப்புகள் மக்களுக்கு நன்மை பயக்கும் என பாராட்டப்பட்டது
entries.rationale: 'The CM's announcements were praised as beneficial to the people' — positive evaluation. (Synthetic balancing example.)

entries.text: திமுக ஆட்சியின் தோல்வி: கட்சி தொண்டர்களிடையே அதிருப்தி
entries.rationale: 'DMK's electoral defeat: shock among party workers' — negative frame toward the DMK. (Synthetic balancing example.)

entries.text: நீர் விநியோகம் தொடர்பாக அரசு விளக்கம் விடுத்தது
entries.rationale: 'Government issues clarification on water distribution' — descriptive.

entries.text: அதிமுக கூட்டணி குழப்பம்: மூத்த தலைமையில் விரிசல்
entries.rationale: 'AIADMK coalition confusion: cracks in the top leadership' — negative evaluative frame.

entries.text: Chief Minister inaugurates 100-bed hospital block in Tiruppur
entries.rationale: Bare event.

entries.text: PMI manufacturing slips to near five-year low in August
entries.rationale: Economic indicator; not framed as government failure in the headline.

entries.text: Stalin says DMK will not give up on party district secretaries affected by new rules
entries.rationale: Reports the leader's statement; Stalin's stance is protective/supportive of his cadre.

entries.text: TVK’s first year: big rallies, thin organisation — a mixed report card
entries.rationale: 'big rallies' + 'thin organisation', 'mixed report card' explicit.

entries.text: BJP
entries.rationale: No content.

entries.text: Cabinet meets today
entries.rationale: Too little context to assign stance.

entries.text: முதல்வர் இன்று சென்னை வருகிறார்
entries.rationale: 'The CM comes to Chennai today' — minimal, no stance.

entries.text: 'Bar Council has no power to act against law students': Supreme Court
entries.rationale: Reports a court holding verbatim.

entries.text: Centre slashes sugar dealers' stock limit to 2,000 quintals from 15 September
entries.rationale: Policy action reported plainly.

entries.text: Singai G. Ramachandran appointed Chairperson of Tamil Nadu Startup and Innovation Mission
entries.rationale: Appointment via GO, descriptive.

entries.text: Envoys of Japan, U.K. in Chennai call on Vijay
entries.rationale: Diplomatic meeting, bare event.

entries.text: Katchatheevu row resurfaces in Assembly; TVK Ministers accuse then DMK govt. of failing to stop handover
entries.rationale: Author reports the row; the quoted TVK ministers are critical of the former DMK government.
